newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices firm, trade cautious.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices firm, trade cautious.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange volume fell to 1,403 kilos on Wednesday from Tuesday's 1,546 kilos in cautious trade as dealers awaited a firm direction in the world markets, dealers said.
Gold closed firmer on the day at $321.05 an ounce and 1,590,000 lira per gram, compared to $320.10 and 1,585,000 lira at Tuesday's close.

Most of the day's trade -- 1,113 kilos -- took place in the morning session when lira prices brushed a low of 1,580,400 and dollar prices hovered around $320, amid expectations of firmer levels in the afternoon.
Turkish lira closed sligthly easier at 153,880 to the dollar compared to Tuesday's 153,800 in line with dollar/mark parity.
Of the day's trade, 66.5 percent was conducted in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875.
